name: Ambrosia Filament
summary: Premium US retail line marketed as 'Filament of the Gods', relaunched in December 2024 as the house brand of West3D Printing. Sold on AMS-friendly cardboard spools through a curated distributor network rather than direct mass-market channels. Who actually extrudes the material is not disclosed anywhere in the brand's own materials.

oem_relationships.notes: Ambrosia is West3D's house brand; West3D runs the brand and its primary storefront. West3D is not itself known to extrude, so the actual manufacturer remains unidentified.

product_lines.name: Dolos PLA
product_lines.notes: Colour-shift/chameleon PLA; mapped to pla-gradient as the nearest colour-varying id, though the shift here is angle/temperature-driven rather than along-strand.

product_lines.name: ABS Matte / Uber ABS+
product_lines.notes: Matte-finish standard ABS plus a toughened 'Uber ABS+' grade.

product_lines.name: ASA (incl. Galactic, GF and CF)
product_lines.notes: Standard ASA plus glitter, glass-fibre and carbon-fibre variants.

product_lines.name: PC-CF
product_lines.notes: Carbon-fibre-filled polycarbonate; no pc-cf id exists in the catalog, so only the matrix id applies.

product_lines.name: PHA
product_lines.notes: Polyhydroxyalkanoate or PLA/PHA blend; the listing does not state blend ratio.

additional_notes: Pricing roughly USD 19-40/kg. Cardboard spools are marketed as AMS-compatible. manufacturing_countries is left empty on purpose: no extrusion site, contract manufacturer or country of origin is disclosed for any line, and West3D is a retailer rather than a known extruder. Status is draft rather than researched because confidence is low.

provenance.conflicts: No legal entity, extrusion partner or country of manufacture was found. The West3D house-brand relationship is inferred from storefront ownership and the December 2024 relaunch announcement rather than from a corporate statement.
